material_news_signals.description: How far does Dak Prescott slip in Nick Shook's QB rankings after the Cowboys' most recent collapse? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz editor s update wentz will start for the vikings in week 9 as murray deals with a hamstring injury i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl thursday nov 5 why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in any of those contests and zay flowers just put up a goose egg zero catches on five targets versus buffalo things are at risk of falling apart and the ravens don t exactly have one of their classic shutdown defenses of yesteryear to come to the rescue sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable comeback defeat at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses all while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game during its three game losing streak second most in the league no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three fewest point totals and three fewest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards between week 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 are more than watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with a better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in pittsburgh the saints defense has been anything but great against the run allowing 139 4 rush yards per game 29th in the nfl and have given up north of 100 yards in all but one game in 2026 but i do see this being a get right game for the saints on all fronts fresh off the bye changes were made to the run game firing run game coordinator t j paganetti signing rb audric estim 233 and the kicking ranks charlie smyth is expected to handle kicking duties after daniel carlson s release and the entire roster got a little healthier first round receiver jordyn tyson returned to practice and could be a boon if he indeed makes his nfl debut for tyler shough opposite chris olave getting kelvin banks back along an o line that has struggled to keep shough clean in the pocket should also benefit kellen moore s unit sanders can smile all he wants but the saints will get the last laugh sunday why jeremy picked the giants in a meeting of former michigan men j j mccarthy and joe milton backups on other franchises in september will renew one of the nfl s fiercest rivalries to kick off november mccarthy will get his second start leading the giants offense while milton on his third team will see his first ever nfl start for philly after being called on to replace an ineffective tanner mckee big blue has played close games under john harbaugh they ve entered the last minute of each of their tilts separated on one score or less save for the rams debacle and this one should be no different even against a beat up eagles side philly historically plays new york well at home the giants have dropped 12 straight at a hostile lincoln financial field and the infusion of milton to the offense could provide a spark for nick sirianni s side milton is a bomb thrower averaging the second most air yards per attempt since 2024 min 50 attempts in his relief appearances mccarthy has had a similar run of play in his six quarters helping make malik nabers the reigning offensive player of the month there will be big plays and maybe bigger mistakes made in sunday s game but unlike the injury riddled eagles the 26 giants know how to win tight tussles and should ride the amtrak back to new jersey victorious why jeremy picked the rams sean mcvay will coach the rams in d c on sunday for the first time in front of a home crowd since he left for los angeles in 2017 after three years as washington oc mcvay s rams played in landover during 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4 but on a two game winning streak the commanders are also amid a midseason turnaround after a get right win out of the bye over the wounded eagles but jayden daniels and co may be running into a buzzsaw in a rams defense that could return myles garrett who returned to practice this week if the reigning dpoy is in the lineup he will line up alongside three time dpoy aaron donald for the first time since both joined the rams this offseason perhaps it ll be the straw that breaks opponents backs donald has yet to log a sack this season daniels has played carefully since his injury he hasn t thrown a pick this season and washington has just three giveaways on the year the qb may need to let it loose sunday to keep up with matthew stafford and the fourth ranked rams offense this one will be closer than most expect but l a presents a much more difficult task for the commanders than tanner mckee s eagles why dan picked the texans when the chargers take the field on sunday it will have been nearly a full month since they last scored a touchdown yes there was a bye week during that stretch but still they ve gone nine full quarters without putting the ball in the end zone scoring just 15 points five field goals in that span in other words woof now the texans have been nearly as disappointing as their week 9 opponent last we saw houston it was being overpowered in overtime by a j j mccarthy led offense to fall to 2 5 demeco ryans squad enjoys a rest advantage though coming off a bye and has done a respectable job of putting points on the board thanks to a reassuring year 4 showing from c j stroud that flies a bit under the radar because of the team s struggles the outlook might be bleak for the texans right now but if they have any hope of salvaging their season they cannot let the chargers win their first game since dec 21 2025 why brooke picked the 49ers the raiders snapped their four game skid a road win over the jets parlaying that into two straight isn t likely as they head to santa clara to face the 49ers it s true that san francisco struggled big time with turnovers prior to the bye with the offense coughing up eight giveaways in the last three games and christian mccaffrey and mike evans are still dealing with injuries it s also true that these niners have the advantage in most major categories per nfl pro the two exceptions are overall passing efficiency and pressure rate when the raiders offense and 49ers defense share the field enter nick bosa who s in line to play for the first time since sept 20 and deforest buckner the former colts dt who was drafted by the niners in 2016 general manager john lynch traded for during the break per next gen stats when aligned as a dt buckner has recorded four sacks tied for second most 15 pressures tied for 16th six quick pressures tied for ninth and eight quarterback hits tied for fourth through the first seven weeks of the season despite being double teamed 83 times as a pass rusher tied for seventh most among dts in addition he has one missed tackle on 32 tackle attempts tied for the fewest at the position with 25 or more attempts buckner s addition should pay dividends for san francisco moving forward beginning sunday against the visiting raiders why brooke picked the patriots the packers and patriots have had the same results every week of the 2026 season and i pray they don t follow suit in week 9 because that would mean a dreaded tie please no these clubs have won four of their last five games significantly improving upon their rocky starts and feature many similar aspects including top 10 defenses the countdown to micah parsons return to game action is on and quarterbacks who aren t afraid to heave it deep green bay s jordan love leads the nfl with 21 completions of 25 plus yards and downfield pass yards 1 253 in 2026 per next gen stats new england s drake maye sits third in both categories but first in pass tds four of 40 plus yards so we should expect some explosive plays come sunday regardless of which pass catchers are healthy enough to take the field the one area that continues to trip me up is the packers run game that unit welcomed josh jacobs back from suspension two games ago and nothing s changed it s averaging an nfl worst 60 6 rush yards per game in 2026 which would be the fewest by any team in a season since the 1970 merger and a ghastly 2 9 yards per carry i m not confident that changes sunday against a new england defense allowing the sixth fewest rush yards per game 92 6 it s a weakness the packers have been able to overcome in past weeks but it ll catch up to them this time why gennaro picked the seahawks in their first game of this season the cardinals upset the overrated chargers only to be smashed by the sam darnold less seahawks on the following sunday in their first game of this month the cardinals upset the overrated cowboys and look who s on the slate this sunday the sam darnold less seahawks with darnold sidelined this week by a fresh quad injury seattle plans to roll out drew lock against the cards once again as long as the backup qb isn t hindered by a recent elbow issue lock performed admirably in his winning spot start at arizona back in week 2 tossing three touchdown passes to jaxon smith njigba in an efficient outing that saw him complete over 73 of his throws and post a dazzling 139 1 passer rating can the second stringer log a second win over this division rival with jsn at his disposal and seattle s defense on his side lock doesn t have to play hero especially against an arizona team pulling its own levers at quarterback gardner minshew has taken the job from baltimore bound jacoby brissett do i believe in minshew mania well as a nothing to lose late game endeavor against the cowboys moribund defense sure but in the journeyman s first start of the season at seattle against the league s top ranked defense with the seahawks fresh off a humbling nationally televised home loss not so much mania is a fleeting sensation why dan picked the bears i believe the clock is about to strike midnight on the bucs recent cinderella like run after an 0 4 start to the season their recipe for success is not sustainable long term they won by 30 points a couple weeks ago despite throwing for just 64 yards and then they were victorious last week in a rain soaked game where they didn t complete a single pass becoming the first team since the 1974 buffalo bills to do so meanwhile the bears have planted their flag as a legit contender with prime time wins at home against the reigning afc east champion patriots and on the road versus the reigning super bowl champion seahawks in consecutive weeks the defense is operating on a different level with trade acquisition jeffery simmons wreaking havoc and caleb williams is generating mvp chatter tampa bay s defense will be the best he s faced since leaving chicago s week 3 loss to the vikings with the hamstring injury that sidelined him for three full games but i think it will take multiple takeaways by todd bowles defense to jeopardize the bears winning streak the home team has more paths to victory than the bucs do right now monday nov 9 why bobby picked the bills with kyler murray battling a hamstring injury carson wentz is starting this game for the vikings frankly that development doesn t really change my feelings about this matchup which never hinged on the home team s quarterback minnesota s best chance at coming away with a victory will be to blitz josh allen into oblivion and hope it disrupts buffalo s offense enough to result in a low scoring slugfest defensive coordinator brian flores as everyone knows is very much up to that task his defense is blitzing at a rate of 71 0 which is 30 7 higher than the second ranked giants 40 3 per nfl pro for an idea of how absurd that is the gap between giants and the least blitz happy team bengals 18 9 is 21 4 allen hasn t been particularly amazing against the blitz comparative to the rest of the league he is currently 20th out of 31 qualified quarterbacks with an 88 2 passer rating when facing extra rushers however that pack against the run while minnesota has allowed the fewest passing yards in the nfl it s given up the 17th most rushing yards suffice it to say the bills will find a way to get theirs i m not so sure news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 9: Dak Prescott exits top 10; Cam Ward heating up
news_mentions.description: How far does Dak Prescott slip in Nick Shook's QB rankings after the Cowboys' most recent collapse? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz editor s update wentz will start for the vikings in week 9 as murray deals with a hamstring injury i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs isn't worrying over whether additional allegations will lead to more punishment
news_mentions.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs says he isn’t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs says he isn t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations that were made against him years before he pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend with all the evidence that we have and that they have at this point it s not one of those things where i m sitting back on my hands like ok am i going to play this week jacobs said wednesday it s like i kind of already know what it is so it s like it s really just up to them to make their final decision but i m not worried about feeling like i m going to miss any more time than i already have after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs has returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar allegations from years before lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release they said those allegations are old are hearsay and easily disproven it really feels like an attack on me and who i am and my character jacobs said wednesday and at the end of the day there s a lot of stuff being said about me that s completely false like completely made up and it s like people just run with it and i can t change that it s just one of those thing where it s like ok all i can do is try to be who i am and try not to let the negative moments change who i am and that was the biggest thing for me throughout this whole process i didn t want to go to a place where i felt like i was closed off and i m angry all the time because of what s going on in my life jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl has declined comment on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars vs. Ravens: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 9 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

news_mentions.headline: Week 9 NFL MVP tracker: Can Caleb Williams join Joe Montana in making history?
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at the MVP race heading into Week 9 on the 2026 season. Can Bears QB Caleb Williams do something only accomplished by Joe Montana? Plus, Joe Burrow makes a push into the top five.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams on monday night did what no quarterback has done this season bamboozle the seattle seahawks defense mike macdonald s group entered monday s tilt allowing a league low 144 4 passing yards per game and the stingiest total yards per game 233 9 no qb had hit the 200 yard passing mark against seattle this season the seahawks flustered brock purdy in week 5 into his lowest output 189 yards they flummoxed patrick mahomes 165 and stonewalled running back kenneth walker 36 in week 7 then the bears and williams rolled over them like a ford f 450 super duty blasting through a pinto en route to a 34 17 win williams completed 70 6 of his passes 24 for 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions his third game with at least one touchdown zero interceptions and a 70 or higher completion percentage this season tied for most in the nfl per nfl research williams is the first qb with such a game against the seahawks since baker mayfield in week 5 2025 jordan love and jared goff both in 2024 are the only other qbs with such a game against seattle since macdonald became the coach in 2024 mastermind ben johnson deserves credit for a chicago offense that keeps defenses off kilter the bears offensive line is as strong as any in the league the running backs keep yards churning and the wide receivers create space and gobble up yards after the catch but it all funnels through williams the qb was sublime on monday night in the face of the nfl s top defense in a hostile road environment at lumen field there were a few hiccups including some errant throws and three three and outs but overall williams showed he is in complete command of johnson s offense that should scare the rest of the nfc i went over williams improvement in year 2 under johnson in last week s column again the qb showed the ability to play within the offense and take the layups when they re there against the seahawks he also feasted off play action with a 40 0 downfield rate off play action and a 23 5 explosive play rate in week 8 his highest of the season per next gen stats what i didn t get into last week was how a hamstring injury that wiped out three games could dash any shot williams has at swiping this year s mvp award history says he s a long shot simply because of those missed games in the post nfl afl merger era since 1970 in non strike shortened seasons only one player has missed three games and still won the nfl mvp award joe montana in 1989 joe cool battled through various injuries that season missing weeks 6 8 and 15 and portions of others every single other mvp missed two or fewer tilts most missed zero here is a complete list of games missed for mvps since 1970 not counting john elway in 1987 and kicker mark moseley in 1982 both strike shortened years 1972 rb larry brown weeks 13 and 14 1989 qb joe montana weeks 6 8 15 1990 qb joe montana week 16 1991 rb thurman thomas week 17 1993 rb emmitt smith weeks 1 and 2 2000 rb marshall faulk weeks 9 and 10 2003 qb steve mcnair weeks 15 and 17 2011 qb aaron rodgers week 18 2019 qb lamar jackson week 18 2021 qb aaron rodgers week 9 2023 qb lamar jackson week 18 that s 11 players out of 53 who missed even a single game during their mvp seasons many of those came at the end of the regular season with players sitting out to prep for a postseason run aside from rodgers positive covid test in 2021 no qb has missed a game due to injury in their mvp season since steve mcnair in 2003 of the five mvps who missed more than a single game three were running backs who racked up enough stats to run away with the award emmitt smith famously sat out the first two games in a contract standoff with the cowboys in 1993 mcnair split the award with peyton manning after missing a couple of late games with calf and ankle injuries the titans qb led the nfl in passer rating and yards per attempt that year mvp voters have leaned toward qbs who rack up stats and stay on the field in 2016 there was some chatter particularly in the northeast as to whether tom brady who missed the first four games of the season due to the deflategate suspension should be considered for the mvp after returning to lead the pats to an 11 1 record with a 28 2 td int ratio brady finished second to the falcons matt ryan with 20 of the vote montana s 1989 season for san francisco sits as the lone outlier despite missing three games montana was the best qb on the best team in the nfl winning the mvp vote in a landslide 62 of 70 votes the 49ers qb overcame the lack of counting stats by leading the nfl in all the efficiency categories 70 2 completion rate a 6 7 td rate 53 7 success rate 9 1 yards per attempt average 270 8 yards per game and set the then record with a 112 4 passer rating when 100 passer ratings were uncommon that s williams path to the mvp be the most efficient passer on the best team the bears qb currently sits second in completion percentage 70 9 fourth in interception rate 0 6 eighth in success rate 49 7 fifth in yards per attempt 8 0 11th in yards per game 253 4 fifth in passer rating 104 6 while ranking second in qbr 78 9 third in epa per dropback 0 22 and fifth in win probability added 117 0 overcoming missed games in terms of the mvp race is extremely difficult missing three is historically daunting williams isn t there yet but if he manhandles other defenses like he did a studly seahawks one on the road he ll have a shot at joining montana as an outlier in the record books now on to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition next in line bears qb caleb williams lions qb jared goff jahmyr gibbs drake maye
