news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can Kyle Hamilton and the Ravens' defense fuel an upset of the Trevor Lawrence-led Jaguars on "Thursday Night Football"? Will the Bengals stay hot in a potential shootout in Madrid? Who wins an enticing interconference showdown between the Packers and Patriots? Check out the Week 9 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl thursday nov 5 why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in any of those contests and zay flowers just put up a goose egg zero catches on five targets versus buffalo things are at risk of falling apart and the ravens don t exactly have one of their classic shutdown defenses of yesteryear to come to the rescue sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable comeback defeat at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses all while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game during its three game losing streak second most in the league no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three fewest point totals and three fewest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards between week 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 are more than watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with a better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in pittsburgh the saints defense has been anything but great against the run allowing 139 4 rush yards per game 29th in the nfl and have given up north of 100 yards in all but one game in 2026 but i do see this being a get right game for the saints on all fronts fresh off the bye changes were made to the run game firing run game coordinator t j paganetti signing rb audric estim 233 and the kicking ranks charlie smyth is expected to handle kicking duties after daniel carlson s release and the entire roster got a little healthier first round receiver jordyn tyson returned to practice and could be a boon if he indeed makes his nfl debut for tyler shough opposite chris olave getting kelvin banks back along an o line that has struggled to keep shough clean in the pocket should also benefit kellen moore s unit sanders can smile all he wants but the saints will get the last laugh sunday why jeremy picked the giants in a meeting of former michigan men j j mccarthy and joe milton backups on other franchises in september will renew one of the nfl s fiercest rivalries to kick off november mccarthy will get his second start leading the giants offense while milton on his third team will see his first ever nfl start for philly after being called on to replace an ineffective tanner mckee big blue has played close games under john harbaugh they ve entered the last minute of each of their tilts separated on one score or less save for the rams debacle and this one should be no different even against a beat up eagles side philly historically plays new york well at home the giants have dropped 12 straight at a hostile lincoln financial field and the infusion of milton to the offense could provide a spark for nick sirianni s side milton is a bomb thrower averaging the second most air yards per attempt since 2024 min 50 attempts in his relief appearances mccarthy has had a similar run of play in his six quarters helping make malik nabers the reigning offensive player of the month there will be big plays and maybe bigger mistakes made in sunday s game but unlike the injury riddled eagles the 26 giants know how to win tight tussles and should ride the amtrak back to new jersey victorious why jeremy picked the rams sean mcvay will coach the rams in d c on sunday for the first time in front of a home crowd since he left for los angeles in 2017 after three years as washington oc mcvay s rams played in landover during 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4 but on a two game winning streak the commanders are also amid a midseason turnaround after a get right win out of the bye over the wounded eagles but jayden daniels and co may be running into a buzzsaw in a rams defense that could return myles garrett who returned to practice this week if the reigning dpoy is in the lineup he will line up alongside three time dpoy aaron donald for the first time since both joined the rams this offseason perhaps it ll be the straw that breaks opponents backs donald has yet to log a sack this season daniels has played carefully since his injury he hasn t thrown a pick this season and washington has just three giveaways on the year the qb may need to let it loose sunday to keep up with matthew stafford and the fourth ranked rams offense this one will be closer than most expect but l a presents a much more difficult task for the commanders than tanner mckee s eagles why dan picked the texans when the chargers take the field on sunday it will have been nearly a full month since they last scored a touchdown yes there was a bye week during that stretch but still they ve gone nine full quarters without putting the ball in the end zone scoring just 15 points five field goals in that span in other words woof now the texans have been nearly as disappointing as their week 9 opponent last we saw houston it was being overpowered in overtime by a j j mccarthy led offense to fall to 2 5 demeco ryans squad enjoys a rest advantage though coming off a bye and has done a respectable job of putting points on the board thanks to a reassuring year 4 showing from c j stroud that flies a bit under the radar because of the team s struggles the outlook might be bleak for the texans right now but if they have any hope of salvaging their season they cannot let the chargers win their first game since dec 21 2025 why brooke picked the 49ers the raiders snapped their four game skid a road win over the jets parlaying that into two straight isn t likely as they head to santa clara to face the 49ers it s true that san francisco struggled big time with turnovers prior to the bye with the offense coughing up eight giveaways in the last three games and christian mccaffrey and mike evans are still dealing with injuries it s also true that these niners have the advantage in most major categories per nfl pro the two exceptions are overall passing efficiency and pressure rate when the raiders offense and 49ers defense share the field enter nick bosa who s in line to play for the first time since sept 20 and deforest buckner the former colts dt who was drafted by the niners in 2016 general manager john lynch traded for during the break per next gen stats when aligned as a dt buckner has recorded four sacks tied for second most 15 pressures tied for 16th six quick pressures tied for ninth and eight quarterback hits tied for fourth through the first seven weeks of the season despite being double teamed 83 times as a pass rusher tied for seventh most among dts in addition he has one missed tackle on 32 tackle attempts tied for the fewest at the position with 25 or more attempts buckner s addition should pay dividends for san francisco moving forward beginning sunday against the visiting raiders why brooke picked the patriots the packers and patriots have had the same results every week of the 2026 season and i pray they don t follow suit in week 9 because that would mean a dreaded tie please no these clubs have won four of their last five games significantly improving upon their rocky starts and feature many similar aspects including top 10 defenses the countdown to micah parsons return to game action is on and quarterbacks who aren t afraid to heave it deep green bay s jordan love leads the nfl with 21 completions of 25 plus yards and downfield pass yards 1 253 in 2026 per next gen stats new england s drake maye sits third in both categories but first in pass tds four of 40 plus yards so we should expect some explosive plays come sunday regardless of which pass catchers are healthy enough to take the field the one area that continues to trip me up is the packers run game that unit welcomed josh jacobs back from suspension two games ago and nothing s changed it s averaging an nfl worst 60 6 rush yards per game in 2026 which would be the fewest by any team in a season since the 1970 merger and a ghastly 2 9 yards per carry i m not confident that changes sunday against a new england defense allowing the sixth fewest rush yards per game 92 6 it s a weakness the packers have been able to overcome in past weeks but it ll catch up to them this time why gennaro picked the seahawks in their first game of this season the cardinals upset the overrated chargers only to be smashed by the sam darnold less seahawks on the following sunday in their first game of this month the cardinals upset the overrated cowboys and look who s on the slate this sunday the sam darnold less seahawks with darnold sidelined this week by a fresh quad injury seattle plans to roll out drew lock against the cards once again as long as the backup qb isn t hindered by a recent elbow issue lock performed admirably in his winning spot start at arizona back in week 2 tossing three touchdown passes to jaxon smith njigba in an efficient outing that saw him complete over 73 of his throws and post a dazzling 139 1 passer rating can the second stringer log a second win over this division rival with jsn at his disposal and seattle s defense on his side lock doesn t have to play hero especially against an arizona team pulling its own levers at quarterback gardner minshew has taken the job from baltimore bound jacoby brissett do i believe in minshew mania well as a nothing to lose late game endeavor against the cowboys moribund defense sure but in the journeyman s first start of the season at seattle against the league s top ranked defense with the seahawks fresh off a humbling nationally televised home loss not so much mania is a fleeting sensation why dan picked the bears i believe the clock is about to strike midnight on the bucs recent cinderella like run after an 0 4 start to the season their recipe for success is not sustainable long term they won by 30 points a couple weeks ago despite throwing for just 64 yards and then they were victorious last week in a rain soaked game where they didn t complete a single pass becoming the first team since the 1974 buffalo bills to do so meanwhile the bears have planted their flag as a legit contender with prime time wins at home against the reigning afc east champion patriots and on the road versus the reigning super bowl champion seahawks in consecutive weeks the defense is operating on a different level with trade acquisition jeffery simmons wreaking havoc and caleb williams is generating mvp chatter tampa bay s defense will be the best he s faced since leaving chicago s week 3 loss to the vikings with the hamstring injury that sidelined him for three full games but i think it will take multiple takeaways by todd bowles defense to jeopardize the bears winning streak the home team has more paths to victory than the bucs do right now monday nov 9 why bobby picked the bills with kyler murray battling a hamstring injury carson wentz is starting this game for the vikings frankly that development doesn t really change my feelings about this matchup which never hinged on the home team s quarterback minnesota s best chance at coming away with a victory will be to blitz josh allen into oblivion and hope it disrupts buffalo s offense enough to result in a low scoring slugfest defensive coordinator brian flores as everyone knows is very much up to that task his defense is blitzing at a rate of 71 0 which is 30 7 higher than the second ranked giants 40 3 per nfl pro for an idea of how absurd that is the gap between giants and the least blitz happy team bengals 18 9 is 21 4 allen hasn t been particularly amazing against the blitz comparative to the rest of the league he is currently 20th out of 31 qualified quarterbacks with an 88 2 passer rating when facing extra rushers however that doesn t take into account the times he beats it with his legs and running back james cook could also very well take some weight off allen s shoulders against a defense that is in the middle of the pack against the run while minnesota has allowed the fewest passing yards in the nfl it s given up the 17th most rushing yards suffice it to say the bills will find a way to get theirs i m not so sure the vikings will which could result in a second straight loss to a premier offense they fail to keep up with visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: NFL teams made 22 in-season trades in 2025. Only a handful truly paid off
news_mentions.body_text: once an afterthought on the league calendar the nfl 39 s trade deadline has turned into a frenzy general managers no longer hesitate to ship draft capital for potentially season saving help wheeling and dealing from the opening week of the season through the nov 10 deadline but activity doesn 39 t guarantee improvement while some gambles pay off others squander picks on moves teams quickly regret looking back at last season 39 s 22 in season trades here 39 s how those investments graded out and whether they proved wise or wasteful jets db ja 39 sir taylor chargers 2028 conditional seventh round pick wasted move taylor appeared in eight games one start and recorded just 13 tackles and no interceptions for the new york jets who went 1 7 in those games chargers ot trevor penning saints 2027 sixth round pick solid deal penning provided good depth starting four of the seven games in which he appeared he then re signed with the los angeles chargers on a one year deal cowboys dt quinnen williams jets dt mazi smith 2026 second round pick 2027 first round pick lopsided so far williams has appeared in 15 games for the dallas cowboys totaling 50 tackles 14 0 tackles for loss 6 5 sacks and a forced fumble he signed a three year 105 9 million extension in august the jets have yet to see a return on their compensation smith appeared in three games without recording any stats before signing with the green bay packers in free agency second round cornerback d 39 angelo ponds has five tackles in six games no starts bears de joe tryon shoyinka 2026 seventh round pick browns 2026 sixth round pick wasted move a first round pick of the tampa bay buccaneers in 2021 tryon shoyinka never panned out with the cleveland browns or chicago bears he appeared in eight games for each franchise combining for 21 tackles 1 0 tackles for loss and zero sacks he signed with the philadelphia eagles in free agency but retired three months later seahawks wr rashid shaheed saints 2026 fourth and fifth round picks home run for seahawks shaheed nbsp made an instant impact as a return man for the seattle seahawks and also contributed as a pass catcher in the nfc divisional round he returned the opening kickoff for a touchdown the seahawks rewarded him with a three year 51 million extension in march the new orleans saints used those two picks on offensive lineman jeremiah wright six appearances one start and safety lorenzo styles three appearances two tackles colts cb sauce gardner jets 2026 first round pick 2027 first round pick wr adonai mitchell win for jets both teams have benefitted from his deal though the jets appear to have gotten the better end of this trade mitchell has emerged as a playmaker recording 40 catches for 566 yards and three touchdowns in 12 games with the team the jets used the 2026 first round pick to draft tight end kenyon sadiq who has 17 catches for 186 yards and a touchdown in eight games gardner has already missed four games during his indianapolis colts tenure even when he 39 s been healthy he 39 s been far from the shut down cover the team envisioned now the colts find themselves in fire sale mode jaguars wr jakobi meyers raiders 2026 fourth and sixth round picks good move meyers fit right in with the jacksonville jaguars last season amassing 42 catches for 483 yards and three touchdowns in nine games he signed a three year 60 million extension last december this season he ranks third on the team in receptions 22 and receiving yards 309 cowboys lb logan wilson bengals 2026 seventh round pick wasted move the cowboys hoped wilson would help improve their struggling defense and he did appear in seven games starting one he recorded 24 tackles but dallas went 4 4 after the trade deadline and missed the playoffs wilson retired this past offseason ravens lb dre 39 mont jones titans 2026 conditional fifth round draft pick solid deal as far as rentals go jones yielded a solid return for the baltimore ravens he added much needed pass rush help though baltimore narrowly missed the postseason in nine games jones led the team with 15 quarterback hits to go along with 17 tackles and 2 5 sacks eagles lb jaelan phillips dolphins 2026 third round pick wasted move phillips contributed 28 tackles and two sacks in eight games philadelphia went 5 4 down the stretch to reach the postseason but lost in the wild card round phillips signed with the carolina panthers in free agency eagles cb jaire alexander 2027 seventh round pick ravens 2026 sixth round pick wasted move alexander wound up never playing for the eagles opting instead to step away from the game to tend to his mental and physical health eagles cb michael carter 2027 seventh round pick jets wr john metchie 2027 sixth round pick win win both teams got what they needed carter added depth and versatility to the secondary but he started only one of eight games in which he appeared metchie added a playmaker to the jets 39 wide receiver unit he caught 29 passes for 256 yards and two touchdowns in nine games steelers kyle dugger 2026 seventh round pick patriots 2026 sixth round pick good move dugger gave the pittsburgh steelers a starter who made his presence felt with 42 tackles two interceptions one returned for a touchdown and five pass breakups 49ers de keion white 2026 seventh round pick patriots 2026 sixth round pick solid deal white gave the san francisco 49ers another rotational piece who in nine games added 1 5 sacks and 12 tackles he remains on the team and has started six of seven games this season recording 3 5 sacks and 13 tackles rams cb roger mccreary conditional 2026 sixth round pick titans 2026 conditional fifth round pick wasted move mccreary appeared in six games but played sparingly recording just two tackles jaguars cb greg newsome 2026 sixth round pick browns cb tyson campbell 2026 seventh round pick solid deal campbell brought the physicality the browns sought for the position he nbsp started the final 12 games last season recording 53 tackles an interception and 12 pass breakups he has started all seven games this season notching 34 tackles three pass breakups and a forced fumble newsome didn 39 t do quite as well with his new team as campbell but he did start 11 of 12 games recording 29 tackles six pass breakups and an interception he signed with the new york giants in free agency chargers de odafe oweh 2027 seventh round pick ravens s alohi gilman 2026 fifth round pick solid deal oweh recorded 7 5 sacks in 12 regular season games and three in the postseason and the move allowed baltimore to clear 9 5 million off its books gilman contributed in the secondary but wasn 39 t a major factor both players departed for other teams in free agency bengals qb joe flacco 2026 sixth round pick browns 2026 fifth round pick good move with joe burrow sidelined with injury the bengals acquired the veteran quarterback from their division rivals flacco provided stability to the offense with burrow sidelined but defensive struggles cost cincinnati which went 1 5 with flacco at the helm browns ot cam robinson 2027 seventh round pick texans 2027 sixth round pick good move robinson filled a pressing need starting 12 of the 13 games he spent with cleveland jets cb jarvis brownlee 2026 seventh round pick titans 2026 sixth round pick wasted move brownlee started two out of seven games and recorded 10 total tackles but he graded out poorly per pro football focus and allowed a passer rating of 116 6 while in coverage he 39 s still with the jets though he continues to struggle saints wr ja 39 lynn polk 2028 seventh round pick patriots 2027 sixth round pick wasted move polk promptly landed on injured reserve and never played a snap for the saints before abruptly retiring this offseason eagles rb tank bigsby jaguars 2026 fifth and sixth round picks good move bigsby provided decent contributions as a rotational piece he averaged 5 9 yards per carry in 2025 and started 2026 on a solid note before suffering a season ending injury this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: The Chiefs are under fire for refusing to QB sneak. Patrick Mahomes says he's willing
news_mentions.body_text: kansas city mo kansas city chiefs quarterback patrick mahomes said he 39 s willing to add qb sneaks back into his game if it helps the team win mahomes was famously injured in 2019 on a quarterback sneak against the denver broncos dislocating his right kneecap he missed two games with the injury and coach andy reid has not had mahomes attempt a quarterback sneak since that 39 s become a notable talking point after sunday 39 s 28 24 road loss to the broncos as the chiefs struggled in short yardage and failed to score a go ahead touchdown on two downs from the broncos 39 1 yard line 34 i 39 ll just put it this way i 39 m going to do whatever it takes to win 34 mahomes said wednesday 34 at the end of the day quarterback sneak whatever that is i 39 ll do whatever it takes it 39 s not like i 39 m scared to go out there and put my body on the line 34 mahomes who returned for week 1 this season after knee surgery in december acknowledged wednesday that his fearlessness on the field has sometimes gotten him in trouble other times his scrambles and creative playmaking have helped the team he also revealed that since 2019 the chiefs have had checks at the line of scrimmage at times to run a quarterback sneak if the defensive look was right over the last seven seasons though that 39 s never happened 34 but it 39 s not like we 39 re scared to call the quarterback sneak 34 mahomes said 34 it 39 s just something that we haven 39 t done 34 data shows k c has been the nfl 39 s most hesitant team recently when it comes to sneaks according to pro football focus pff the chiefs have attempted eight sneak plays since mahomes was injured in 2019 with tight ends blake bell or noah gray under center for each attempt the team last attempted an offensive tight end sneak in the 2022 season however as gray was stuffed on a third and 1 against jacksonville in a divisional round playoff game on jan 21 2023 gray also tried a sneak on a fake field goal in the ensuing 2023 season but in the last three years the team hasn 39 t tried any sneaks when asked on wednesday why the tight end sneak had been taken out of the playbook in recent seasons reid deflected 34 i think that 39 s going to be our first call sunday 34 he deadpanned 34 good question 34 mahomes was much more willing to discuss the topic with reporters the chiefs are the rare team not to use the qb run game in short yardage per trumedia kansas city has run only two quarterback run plays since the 2020 season with the following criteria 8226 third or fourth down and 1 2 yards to go 8226 non scramble under center snap both were option plays for mahomes meaning neither was a straight ahead sneak meanwhile the philadelphia eagles lead the nfl with 143 of those qb runs over that time many of them using their signature 34 tush push 34 the buffalo bills are second at 118 in general sneaks are considered among the most effective short yardage weapons per pff 133 of 177 sneaks have picked up first downs this season in the nfl giving the play a 75 percent success rate 34 we 39 ve been able to execute with other things so i don 39 t think coach reid has put that on me 34 mahomes said of sneaks 34 but at the end of the day if we can 39 t execute with the other things i 39 m sure we 39 re going to have to make changes and that 39 s something that coach reid is not afraid to do is make changes whenever needed so we 39 ll see where that goes 34 one other scenario the chiefs could bring in backup quarterback justin fields to run a sneak in short yardage if they 39 re worried about mahomes 39 health fields is known for his athleticism and was successful on 6 of 7 sneak attempts last season with the new york jets per trumedia reid said wednesday that logistically fields could be an option 34 we could yeah we 39 ll see 34 reid said 34 we 39 ll see where it goes 34 reid has faced plenty of criticism for not attempting the sneak during sunday 39 s game that included former chiefs offensive lineman mitchell schwartz who described the end of the game as an 34 absolute embarrassment 34 on social media 34 can 39 t get a freaking yard from the 1 yard line because you refuse to sneak the ball with a time out 34 schwartz posted on x 34 you have multiple chances at it well deserved loss 34 the broncos defense in particular appeared to have no respect for k c running a sneak on a second and goal play from the 1 denver 39 s defensive linemen spaced out so much that chiefs right guard trey smith was uncovered which left some film observers wondering whether mahomes could 39 ve called a sneak on his own and entered the end zone untouched mahomes commented on that play where running back kenneth walker was eventually stuffed for no gain by saying that 34 it 39 d better work 34 if he decided to look at the broncos 39 formation and go rogue to sneak it while ignoring reid 39 s direction 34 obviously the play call is what we called and we want to execute that play 34 mahomes said 34 they were able to stunt and kind of get people in position where kenneth wasn 39 t able to get going downhill and score a touchdown 133 but that 39 s stuff we evaluate too we learn from and then we try to be better from in the next few weeks like i said the only thing i have is if i do call my own number it 39 s got to work 34 in a larger sense mahomes said he wants the chiefs to find something effective so they don 39 t face the same short yardage struggles they 39 ve had in recent weeks 34 it 39 s not always going to be pretty but you 39 ve got to go out there and make it happen 34 mahomes said 34 that 39 s stuff that we 39 ll continue to work at 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals to trade QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens
news_mentions.description: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: sometimes nfl teams do make the obvious moves the baltimore ravens are finalizing a trade for arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday the deal is expected to be completed over the weekend terms of the swap were not reported and cardinals head coach mike lafleur declined to go into details or confirm the deal out of respect for the process i ll let the process play out with that said lafleur via the cardinals website s darren urban before adding he expected it all to play out in the next few days brissett was benched during sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and demoted to third string on monday the benching coupled with the ravens glaring need at quarterback after losing lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury this week made a swap all too obvious not only was the need clear but brissett will reunite with ravens qb coach israel woolfolk with whom he worked last season in arizona and in cleveland in 2022 that familiarity will help the veteran qb to jump right into the fray it made sense for arizona to move on from brissett after naming gardner minshew the starter and carson beck the backup eventually beck should get some starting reps by trading brissett the cards also shed salary after reworking the qb s deal this offseason the ravens won t acquire brissett before thursday s game against jacksonville but he s expected to start when baltimore faces the los angeles chargers in week 10 on monday night football undrafted rookie joe fagnano will start on thursday night football versus the jags the ravens will be brissett s seventh franchise and mark his seventh different team in seven years the journeyman knows how to pick up an offense and can run the operation in arizona some off target throws began to hurt the offense and he didn t seem the best fit in mike lafleur s scheme but he s a professional who can at least give the ravens an operational distributor losers of three straight heading into thursday night the ravens hope brissett s arrival can help keep them afloat in a tough playoff race baltimore currently sits last in the division at 4 4 and 10th in the afc

news_mentions.headline: Report: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley out for season with turf toe injury
news_mentions.description: The Ravens' quarterback room has received more bad news. Tests revealed that backup QB Tyler Huntley suffered a season-ending turf toe injury, per ESPN.
news_mentions.body_text: the baltimore ravens quarterback room has received more bad news tests revealed that backup qb tyler huntley suffered a season ending turf toe injury espn s adam schefter reported wednesday morning huntley who exited baltimore s week 8 loss to buffalo was already ruled out for thursday s game against the jacksonville jaguars with undrafted rookie joe fagnano set to make the start wednesday s news wipes out any shot huntley had at returning and helping stabilize the position lamar jackson is out indefinitely with a thumb injury the former mvp landing on ir means he will miss at least four weeks and could miss the rest of the season on a short week the ravens had little choice but to turn to fagnano the club added kedon slovis to the active roster and austin reed to the practice squad this week but neither would be ready in such short order the question is whether baltimore makes a move for an established qb in an attempt to buoy its season after slipping to 4 4 after three straight losses recently demoted arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett could be one candidate if the ravens are willing to shell out any draft assets to solve their quarterback quandary before the season spirals completely away

news_mentions.headline: Ravens to start undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano vs. Jaguars on Thursday
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter announced on Tuesday that undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano will start Thursday night's game against the Jaguars.
news_mentions.body_text: the baltimore ravens will start an undrafted rookie at quarterback against the 5 2 jacksonville jaguars head coach jesse minter announced on tuesday that joe fagnano will start thursday night s game against the jaguars fagnano will become the second undrafted rookie qb in ravens history to start a game joining anthony brown in 2022 with lamar jackson injuring his right thumb just one snap into his return this past sunday and tyler huntley suffering a toe injury baltimore had little choice but to turn to fagnano on a short week the rookie took over for the bulk of sunday s loss to the buffalo bills he went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception the ravens added kedon slovis to their active roster and austin reed to the practice squad this week perhaps if they played sunday baltimore could have turned to slovis or imported another veteran but playing thursday virtually guaranteed fagnano who is also dealing with an ankle issue would get the start against a good jags squad fagnano was listed as limited in the team s monday practice estimation was upgraded to a full participant on tuesday with fagnano making his first start on a short week expect a boatload of derrick henry early against a jaguars run defense that just lost stout defensive tackle davon hamilton for the season the undrafted rookie was an excellent story when he made the initial 53 man roster out of camp at the time the ravens couldn t have envisioned they d need him to keep their season alive now it s fagnano versus one of the best teams in the afc as baltimore 4 4 tries to snap a three game losing streak no pressure kid

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars vs. Ravens: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 9 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals to trade QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens
material_news_signals.description: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: sometimes nfl teams do make the obvious moves the baltimore ravens are finalizing a trade for arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday the deal is expected to be completed over the weekend terms of the swap were not reported and cardinals head coach mike lafleur declined to go into details or confirm the deal out of respect for the process i ll let the process play out with that said lafleur via the cardinals website s darren urban before adding he expected it all to play out in the next few days brissett was benched during sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and demoted to third string on monday the benching coupled with the ravens glaring need at quarterback after losing lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury this week made a swap all too obvious not only was the need clear but brissett will reunite with ravens qb coach israel woolfolk with whom he worked last season in arizona and in cleveland in 2022 that familiarity will help the veteran qb to jump right into the fray it made sense for arizona to move on from brissett after naming gardner minshew the starter and carson beck the backup eventually beck should get some starting reps by trading brissett the cards also shed salary after reworking the qb s deal this offseason the ravens won t acquire brissett before thursday s game against jacksonville but he s expected to start when baltimore faces the los angeles chargers in week 10 on monday night football undrafted rookie joe fagnano will start on thursday night football versus the jags the ravens will be brissett s seventh franchise and mark his seventh different team in seven years the journeyman knows how to pick up an offense and can run the operation in arizona some off target throws began to hurt the offense and he didn t seem the best fit in mike lafleur s scheme but he s a professional who can at least give the ravens an operational distributor losers of three straight heading into thursday night the ravens hope brissett s arrival can help keep them afloat in a tough playoff race baltimore currently sits last in the division at 4 4 and 10th in the afc

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley out for season with turf toe injury
material_news_signals.description: The Ravens' quarterback room has received more bad news. Tests revealed that backup QB Tyler Huntley suffered a season-ending turf toe injury, per ESPN.
material_news_signals.body_text: the baltimore ravens quarterback room has received more bad news tests revealed that backup qb tyler huntley suffered a season ending turf toe injury espn s adam schefter reported wednesday morning huntley who exited baltimore s week 8 loss to buffalo was already ruled out for thursday s game against the jacksonville jaguars with undrafted rookie joe fagnano set to make the start wednesday s news wipes out any shot huntley had at returning and helping stabilize the position lamar jackson is out indefinitely with a thumb injury the former mvp landing on ir means he will miss at least four weeks and could miss the rest of the season on a short week the ravens had little choice but to turn to fagnano the club added kedon slovis to the active roster and austin reed to the practice squad this week but neither would be ready in such short order the question is whether baltimore makes a move for an established qb in an attempt to buoy its season after slipping to 4 4 after three straight losses recently demoted arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett could be one candidate if the ravens are willing to shell out any draft assets to solve their quarterback quandary before the season spirals completely away

news_mentions.body_text: week 8 promised some true clashes of titans yes even the tennessee titans gave us an entertaining game and boy did it deliver the final unbeaten team fell on sunday another contender might have watched its season disintegrate with the departure of its star quarterback and one blockbuster trade paid off in box office style on monday night all of that induced significant changes to the nfl hierarchy starting at the very top note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.headline: The Chiefs are under fire for refusing to QB sneak. Patrick Mahomes says he's willing
news_mentions.body_text: kansas city mo kansas city chiefs quarterback patrick mahomes said he 39 s willing to add qb sneaks back into his game if it helps the team win mahomes was famously injured in 2019 on a quarterback sneak against the denver broncos dislocating his right kneecap he missed two games with the injury and coach andy reid has not had mahomes attempt a quarterback sneak since that 39 s become a notable talking point after sunday 39 s 28 24 road loss to the broncos as the chiefs struggled in short yardage and failed to score a go ahead touchdown on two downs from the broncos 39 1 yard line 34 i 39 ll just put it this way i 39 m going to do whatever it takes to win 34 mahomes said wednesday 34 at the end of the day quarterback sneak whatever that is i 39 ll do whatever it takes it 39 s not like i 39 m scared to go out there and put my body on the line 34 mahomes who returned for week 1 this season after knee surgery in december acknowledged wednesday that his fearlessness on the field has sometimes gotten him in trouble other times his scrambles and creative playmaking have helped the team he also revealed that since 2019 the chiefs have had checks at the line of scrimmage at times to run a quarterback sneak if the defensive look was right over the last seven seasons though that 39 s never happened 34 but it 39 s not like we 39 re scared to call the quarterback sneak 34 mahomes said 34 it 39 s just something that we haven 39 t done 34 data shows k c has been the nfl 39 s most hesitant team recently when it comes to sneaks according to pro football focus pff the chiefs have attempted eight sneak plays since mahomes was injured in 2019 with tight ends blake bell or noah gray under center for each attempt the team last attempted an offensive tight end sneak in the 2022 season however as gray was stuffed on a third and 1 against jacksonville in a divisional round playoff game on jan 21 2023 gray also tried a sneak on a fake field goal in the ensuing 2023 season but in the last three years the team hasn 39 t tried any sneaks when asked on wednesday why the tight end sneak had been taken out of the playbook in recent seasons reid deflected 34 i think that 39 s going to be our first call sunday 34 he deadpanned 34 good question 34 mahomes was much more willing to discuss the topic with reporters the chiefs are the rare team not to use the qb run game in short yardage per trumedia kansas city has run only two quarterback run plays since the 2020 season with the following criteria 8226 third or fourth down and 1 2 yards to go 8226 non scramble under center snap both were option plays for mahomes meaning neither was a straight ahead sneak meanwhile the philadelphia eagles lead the nfl with 143 of those qb runs over that time many of them using their signature 34 tush push 34 the buffalo bills are second at 118 in general sneaks are considered among the most effective short yardage weapons per pff 133 of 177 sneaks have picked up first downs this season in the nfl giving the play a 75 percent success rate 34 we 39 ve been able to execute with other things so i don 39 t think coach reid has put that on me 34 mahomes said of sneaks 34 but at the end of the day if we can 39 t execute with the other things i 39 m sure we 39 re going to have to make changes and that 39 s something that coach reid is not afraid to do is make changes whenever needed so we 39 ll see where that goes 34 one other scenario the chiefs could bring in backup quarterback justin fields to run a sneak in short yardage if they 39 re worried about mahomes 39 health fields is known for his athleticism and was successful on 6 of 7 sneak attempts last season with the new york jets per trumedia reid said wednesday that logistically fields could be an option 34 we could yeah we 39 ll see 34 reid said 34 we 39 ll see where it goes 34 reid has faced plenty of criticism for not attempting the sneak during sunday 39 s game that included former chiefs offensive lineman mitchell schwartz who described the end of the game as an 34 absolute embarrassment 34 on social media 34 can 39 t get a freaking yard from the 1 yard line because you refuse to sneak the ball with a time out 34 schwartz posted on x 34 you have multiple chances at it well deserved loss 34 the broncos defense in particular appeared to have no respect for k c running a sneak on a second and goal play from the 1 denver 39 s defensive linemen spaced out so much that chiefs right guard trey smith was uncovered which left some film observers wondering whether mahomes could 39 ve called a sneak on his own and entered the end zone untouched mahomes commented on that play where running back kenneth walker was eventually stuffed for no gain by saying that 34 it 39 d better work 34 if he decided to look at the broncos 39 formation and go rogue to sneak it while ignoring reid 39 s direction 34 obviously the play call is what we called and we want to execute that play 34 mahomes said 34 they were able to stunt and kind of get people in position where kenneth wasn 39 t able to get going downhill and score a touchdown 133 but that 39 s stuff we evaluate too we learn from and then we try to be better from in the next few weeks like i said the only thing i have is if i do call my own number it 39 s got to work 34 in a larger sense mahomes said he wants the chiefs to find something effective so they don 39 t face the same short yardage struggles they 39 ve had in recent weeks 34 it 39 s not always going to be pretty but you 39 ve got to go out there and make it happen 34 mahomes said 34 that 39 s stuff that we 39 ll continue to work at 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic
