news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Detroit Lions' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

news_mentions.headline: NFL teams made 22 in-season trades in 2025. Only a handful truly paid off
news_mentions.body_text: once an afterthought on the league calendar the nfl 39 s trade deadline has turned into a frenzy general managers no longer hesitate to ship draft capital for potentially season saving help wheeling and dealing from the opening week of the season through the nov 10 deadline but activity doesn 39 t guarantee improvement while some gambles pay off others squander picks on moves teams quickly regret looking back at last season 39 s 22 in season trades here 39 s how those investments graded out and whether they proved wise or wasteful jets db ja 39 sir taylor chargers 2028 conditional seventh round pick wasted move taylor appeared in eight games one start and recorded just 13 tackles and no interceptions for the new york jets who went 1 7 in those games chargers ot trevor penning saints 2027 sixth round pick solid deal penning provided good depth starting four of the seven games in which he appeared he then re signed with the los angeles chargers on a one year deal cowboys dt quinnen williams jets dt mazi smith 2026 second round pick 2027 first round pick lopsided so far williams has appeared in 15 games for the dallas cowboys totaling 50 tackles 14 0 tackles for loss 6 5 sacks and a forced fumble he signed a three year 105 9 million extension in august the jets have yet to see a return on their compensation smith appeared in three games without recording any stats before signing with the green bay packers in free agency second round cornerback d 39 angelo ponds has five tackles in six games no starts bears de joe tryon shoyinka 2026 seventh round pick browns 2026 sixth round pick wasted move a first round pick of the tampa bay buccaneers in 2021 tryon shoyinka never panned out with the cleveland browns or chicago bears he appeared in eight games for each franchise combining for 21 tackles 1 0 tackles for loss and zero sacks he signed with the philadelphia eagles in free agency but retired three months later seahawks wr rashid shaheed saints 2026 fourth and fifth round picks home run for seahawks shaheed nbsp made an instant impact as a return man for the seattle seahawks and also contributed as a pass catcher in the nfc divisional round he returned the opening kickoff for a touchdown the seahawks rewarded him with a three year 51 million extension in march the new orleans saints used those two picks on offensive lineman jeremiah wright six appearances one start and safety lorenzo styles three appearances two tackles colts cb sauce gardner jets 2026 first round pick 2027 first round pick wr adonai mitchell win for jets both teams have benefitted from his deal though the jets appear to have gotten the better end of this trade mitchell has emerged as a playmaker recording 40 catches for 566 yards and three touchdowns in 12 games with the team the jets used the 2026 first round pick to draft tight end kenyon sadiq who has 17 catches for 186 yards and a touchdown in eight games gardner has already missed four games during his indianapolis colts tenure even when he 39 s been healthy he 39 s been far from the shut down cover the team envisioned now the colts find themselves in fire sale mode jaguars wr jakobi meyers raiders 2026 fourth and sixth round picks good move meyers fit right in with the jacksonville jaguars last season amassing 42 catches for 483 yards and three touchdowns in nine games he signed a three year 60 million extension last december this season he ranks third on the team in receptions 22 and receiving yards 309 cowboys lb logan wilson bengals 2026 seventh round pick wasted move the cowboys hoped wilson would help improve their struggling defense and he did appear in seven games starting one he recorded 24 tackles but dallas went 4 4 after the trade deadline and missed the playoffs wilson retired this past offseason ravens lb dre 39 mont jones titans 2026 conditional fifth round draft pick solid deal as far as rentals go jones yielded a solid return for the baltimore ravens he added much needed pass rush help though baltimore narrowly missed the postseason in nine games jones led the team with 15 quarterback hits to go along with 17 tackles and 2 5 sacks eagles lb jaelan phillips dolphins 2026 third round pick wasted move phillips contributed 28 tackles and two sacks in eight games philadelphia went 5 4 down the stretch to reach the postseason but lost in the wild card round phillips signed with the carolina panthers in free agency eagles cb jaire alexander 2027 seventh round pick ravens 2026 sixth round pick wasted move alexander wound up never playing for the eagles opting instead to step away from the game to tend to his mental and physical health eagles cb michael carter 2027 seventh round pick jets wr john metchie 2027 sixth round pick win win both teams got what they needed carter added depth and versatility to the secondary but he started only one of eight games in which he appeared metchie added a playmaker to the jets 39 wide receiver unit he caught 29 passes for 256 yards and two touchdowns in nine games steelers kyle dugger 2026 seventh round pick patriots 2026 sixth round pick good move dugger gave the pittsburgh steelers a starter who made his presence felt with 42 tackles two interceptions one returned for a touchdown and five pass breakups 49ers de keion white 2026 seventh round pick patriots 2026 sixth round pick solid deal white gave the san francisco 49ers another rotational piece who in nine games added 1 5 sacks and 12 tackles he remains on the team and has started six of seven games this season recording 3 5 sacks and 13 tackles rams cb roger mccreary conditional 2026 sixth round pick titans 2026 conditional fifth round pick wasted move mccreary appeared in six games but played sparingly recording just two tackles jaguars cb greg newsome 2026 sixth round pick browns cb tyson campbell 2026 seventh round pick solid deal campbell brought the physicality the browns sought for the position he nbsp started the final 12 games last season recording 53 tackles an interception and 12 pass breakups he has started all seven games this season notching 34 tackles three pass breakups and a forced fumble newsome didn 39 t do quite as well with his new team as campbell but he did start 11 of 12 games recording 29 tackles six pass breakups and an interception he signed with the new york giants in free agency chargers de odafe oweh 2027 seventh round pick ravens s alohi gilman 2026 fifth round pick solid deal oweh recorded 7 5 sacks in 12 regular season games and three in the postseason and the move allowed baltimore to clear 9 5 million off its books gilman contributed in the secondary but wasn 39 t a major factor both players departed for other teams in free agency bengals qb joe flacco 2026 sixth round pick browns 2026 fifth round pick good move with joe burrow sidelined with injury the bengals acquired the veteran quarterback from their division rivals flacco provided stability to the offense with burrow sidelined but defensive struggles cost cincinnati which went 1 5 with flacco at the helm browns ot cam robinson 2027 seventh round pick texans 2027 sixth round pick good move robinson filled a pressing need starting 12 of the 13 games he spent with cleveland jets cb jarvis brownlee 2026 seventh round pick titans 2026 sixth round pick wasted move brownlee started two out of seven games and recorded 10 total tackles but he graded out poorly per pro football focus and allowed a passer rating of 116 6 while in coverage he 39 s still with the jets though he continues to struggle saints wr ja 39 lynn polk 2028 seventh round pick patriots 2027 sixth round pick wasted move polk promptly landed on injured reserve and never played a snap for the saints before abruptly retiring this offseason eagles rb tank bigsby jaguars 2026 fifth and sixth round picks good move bigsby provided decent contributions as a rotational piece he averaged 5 9 yards per carry in 2025 and started 2026 on a solid note before suffering a season ending injury this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Carolina Panthers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the Carolina Panthers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.description: Can Kyle Hamilton and the Ravens' defense fuel an upset of the Trevor Lawrence-led Jaguars on "Thursday Night Football"? Will the Bengals stay hot in a potential shootout in Madrid? Who wins an enticing interconference showdown between the Packers and Patriots? Check out the Week 9 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl thursday nov 5 why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in any of those contests and zay flowers just put up a goose egg zero catches on five targets versus buffalo things are at risk of falling apart and the ravens don t exactly have one of their classic shutdown defenses of yesteryear to come to the rescue sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable comeback defeat at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses all while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game during its three game losing streak second most in the league no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three fewest point totals and three fewest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards between week 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 are more than watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with a better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in pittsburgh the saints defense has been anything but great against the run allowing 139 4 rush yards per game 29th in the nfl and have given up north of 100 yards in all but one game in 2026 but i do see this being a get right game for the saints on all fronts fresh off the bye changes were made to the run game firing run game coordinator t j paganetti signing rb audric estim 233 and the kicking ranks charlie smyth is expected to handle kicking duties after daniel carlson s release and the entire roster got a little healthier first round receiver jordyn tyson returned to practice and could be a boon if he indeed makes his nfl debut for tyler shough opposite chris olave getting kelvin banks back along an o line that has struggled to keep shough clean in the pocket should also benefit kellen moore s unit sanders can smile all he wants but the saints will get the last laugh sunday why jeremy picked the giants in a meeting of former michigan men j j mccarthy and joe milton backups on other franchises in september will renew one of the nfl s fiercest rivalries to kick off november mccarthy will get his second start leading the giants offense while milton on his third team will see his first ever nfl start for philly after being called on to replace an ineffective tanner mckee big blue has played close games under john harbaugh they ve entered the last minute of each of their tilts separated on one score or less save for the rams debacle and this one should be no different even against a beat up eagles side philly historically plays new york well at home the giants have dropped 12 straight at a hostile lincoln financial field and the infusion of milton to the offense could provide a spark for nick sirianni s side milton is a bomb thrower averaging the second most air yards per attempt since 2024 min 50 attempts in his relief appearances mccarthy has had a similar run of play in his six quarters helping make malik nabers the reigning offensive player of the month there will be big plays and maybe bigger mistakes made in sunday s game but unlike the injury riddled eagles the 26 giants know how to win tight tussles and should ride the amtrak back to new jersey victorious why jeremy picked the rams sean mcvay will coach the rams in d c on sunday for the first time in front of a home crowd since he left for los angeles in 2017 after three years as washington oc mcvay s rams played in landover during 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4 but on a two game winning streak the commanders are also amid a midseason turnaround after a get right win out of the bye over the wounded eagles but jayden daniels and co may be running into a buzzsaw in a rams defense that could return myles garrett who returned to practice this week if the reigning dpoy is in the lineup he will line up alongside three time dpoy aaron donald for the first time since both joined the rams this offseason perhaps it ll be the straw that breaks opponents backs donald has yet to log a sack this season daniels has played carefully since his injury he hasn t thrown a pick this season and washington has just three giveaways on the year the qb may need to let it loose sunday to keep up with matthew stafford and the fourth ranked rams offense this one will be closer than most expect but l a presents a much more difficult task for the commanders than tanner mckee s eagles why dan picked the texans when the chargers take the field on sunday it will have been nearly a full month since they last scored a touchdown yes there was a bye week during that stretch but still they ve gone nine full quarters without putting the ball in the end zone scoring just 15 points five field goals in that span in other words woof now the texans have been nearly as disappointing as their week 9 opponent last we saw houston it was being overpowered in overtime by a j j mccarthy led offense to fall to 2 5 demeco ryans squad enjoys a rest advantage though coming off a bye and has done a respectable job of putting points on the board thanks to a reassuring year 4 showing from c j stroud that flies a bit under the radar because of the team s struggles the outlook might be bleak for the texans right now but if they have any hope of salvaging their season they cannot let the chargers win their first game since dec 21 2025 why brooke picked the 49ers the raiders snapped their four game skid a road win over the jets parlaying that into two straight isn t likely as they head to santa clara to face the 49ers it s true that san francisco struggled big time with turnovers prior to the bye with the offense coughing up eight giveaways in the last three games and christian mccaffrey and mike evans are still dealing with injuries it s also true that these niners have the advantage in most major categories per nfl pro the two exceptions are overall passing efficiency and pressure rate when the raiders offense and 49ers defense share the field enter nick bosa who s in line to play for the first time since sept 20 and deforest buckner the former colts dt who was drafted by the niners in 2016 general manager john lynch traded for during the break per next gen stats when aligned as a dt buckner has recorded four sacks tied for second most 15 pressures tied for 16th six quick pressures tied for ninth and eight quarterback hits tied for fourth through the first seven weeks of the season despite being double teamed 83 times as a pass rusher tied for seventh most among dts in addition he has one missed tackle on 32 tackle attempts tied for the fewest at the position with 25 or more attempts buckner s addition should pay dividends for san francisco moving forward beginning sunday against the visiting raiders why brooke picked the patriots the packers and patriots have had the same results every week of the 2026 season and i pray they don t follow suit in week 9 because that would mean a dreaded tie please no these clubs have won four of their last five games significantly improving upon their rocky starts and feature many similar aspects including top 10 defenses the countdown to micah parsons return to game action is on and quarterbacks who aren t afraid to heave it deep green bay s jordan love leads the nfl with 21 completions of 25 plus yards and downfield pass yards 1 253 in 2026 per next gen stats new england s drake maye sits third in both categories but first in pass tds four of 40 plus yards so we should expect some explosive plays come sunday regardless of which pass catchers are healthy enough to take the field the one area that continues to trip me up is the packers run game that unit welcomed josh jacobs back from suspension two games ago and nothing s changed it s averaging an nfl worst 60 6 rush yards per game in 2026 which would be the fewest by any team in a season since the 1970 merger and a ghastly 2 9 yards per carry i m not confident that changes sunday against a new england defense allowing the sixth fewest rush yards per game 92 6 it s a weakness the packers have been able to overcome in past weeks but it ll catch up to them this time why gennaro picked the seahawks in their first game of this season the cardinals upset the overrated chargers only to be smashed by the sam darnold less seahawks on the following sunday in their first game of this month the cardinals upset the overrated cowboys and look who s on the slate this sunday the sam darnold less seahawks with darnold sidelined this week by a fresh quad injury seattle plans to roll out drew lock against the cards once again as long as the backup qb isn t hindered by a recent elbow issue lock performed admirably in his winning spot start at arizona back in week 2 tossing three touchdown passes to jaxon smith njigba in an efficient outing that saw him complete over 73 of his throws and post a dazzling 139 1 passer rating can the second stringer log a second win over this division rival with jsn at his disposal and seattle s defense on his side lock doesn t have to play hero especially against an arizona team pulling its own levers at quarterback gardner minshew has taken the job from baltimore bound jacoby brissett do i believe in minshew mania well as a nothing to lose late game endeavor against the cowboys moribund defense sure but in the journeyman s first start of the season at seattle against the league s top ranked defense with the seahawks fresh off a humbling nationally televised home loss not so much mania is a fleeting sensation why dan picked the bears i believe the clock is about to strike midnight on the bucs recent cinderella like run after an 0 4 start to the season their recipe for success is not sustainable long term they won by 30 points a couple weeks ago despite throwing for just 64 yards and then they were victorious last week in a rain soaked game where they didn t complete a single pass becoming the first team since the 1974 buffalo bills to do so meanwhile the bears have planted their flag as a legit contender with prime time wins at home against the reigning afc east champion patriots and on the road versus the reigning super bowl champion seahawks in consecutive weeks the defense is operating on a different level with trade acquisition jeffery simmons wreaking havoc and caleb williams is generating mvp chatter tampa bay s defense will be the best he s faced since leaving chicago s week 3 loss to the vikings with the hamstring injury that sidelined him for three full games but i think it will take multiple takeaways by todd bowles defense to jeopardize the bears winning streak the home team has more paths to victory than the bucs do right now monday nov 9 why bobby picked the bills with kyler murray battling a hamstring injury carson wentz is starting this game for the vikings frankly that development doesn t really change my feelings about this matchup which never hinged on the home team s quarterback minnesota s best chance at coming away with a victory will be to blitz josh allen into oblivion and hope it disrupts buffalo s offense enough to result in a low scoring slugfest defensive coordinator brian flores as everyone knows is very much up to that task his defense is blitzing at a rate of 71 0 which is 30 7 higher than the second ranked giants 40 3 per nfl pro for an idea of how absurd that is the gap between giants and the least blitz happy team bengals 18 9 is 21 4 allen hasn t been particularly amazing against the blitz comparative to the rest of the league he is currently 20th out of 31 qualified quarterbacks with an 88 2 passer rating when facing extra rushers however that doesn t take into account the times he beats it with his legs and running back james cook could also very well take some weight off allen s shoulders against a defense that is in the middle of the pack against the run while minnesota has allowed the fewest passing yards in the nfl it s given up the 17th most rushing yards suffice it to say the bills will find a way to get theirs i m not so sure news_mentions.headline: Week 9 NFL MVP tracker: Can Caleb Williams join Joe Montana in making history?
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at the MVP race heading into Week 9 on the 2026 season. Can Bears QB Caleb Williams do something only accomplished by Joe Montana? Plus, Joe Burrow makes a push into the top five.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams on monday night did what no quarterback has done this season bamboozle the seattle seahawks defense mike macdonald s group entered monday s tilt allowing a league low 144 4 passing yards per game and the stingiest total yards per game 233 9 no qb had hit the 200 yard passing mark against seattle this season the seahawks flustered brock purdy in week 5 into his lowest output 189 yards they flummoxed patrick mahomes 165 and stonewalled running back kenneth walker 36 in week 7 then the bears and williams rolled over them like a ford f 450 super duty blasting through a pinto en route to a 34 17 win williams completed 70 6 of his passes 24 for 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions his third game with at least one touchdown zero interceptions and a 70 or higher completion percentage this season tied for most in the nfl per nfl research williams is the first qb with such a game against the seahawks since baker mayfield in week 5 2025 jordan love and jared goff both in 2024 are the only other qbs with such a game against seattle since macdonald became the coach in 2024 mastermind ben johnson deserves credit for a chicago offense that keeps defenses off kilter the bears offensive line is as strong as any in the league the running backs keep yards churning and the wide receivers create space and gobble up yards after the catch but it all funnels through williams the qb was sublime on monday night in the face of the nfl s top defense in a hostile road environment at lumen field there were a few hiccups including some errant throws and three three and outs but overall williams showed he is in complete command of johnson s offense that should scare the rest of the nfc i went over williams improvement in year 2 under johnson in last week s column again the qb showed the ability to play within the offense and take the layups when they re there against the seahawks he also feasted off play action with a 40 0 downfield rate off play action and a 23 5 explosive play rate in week 8 his highest of the season per next gen stats what i didn t get into last week was how a hamstring injury that wiped out three games could dash any shot williams has at swiping this year s mvp award history says he s a long shot simply because of those missed games in the post nfl afl merger era since 1970 in non strike shortened seasons only one player has missed three games and still won the nfl mvp award joe montana in 1989 joe cool battled through various injuries that season missing weeks 6 8 and 15 and portions of others every single other mvp missed two or fewer tilts most missed zero here is a complete list of games missed for mvps since 1970 not counting john elway in 1987 and kicker mark moseley in 1982 both strike shortened years 1972 rb larry brown weeks 13 and 14 1989 qb joe montana weeks 6 8 15 1990 qb joe montana week 16 1991 rb thurman thomas week 17 1993 rb emmitt smith weeks 1 and 2 2000 rb marshall faulk weeks 9 and 10 2003 qb steve mcnair weeks 15 and 17 2011 qb aaron rodgers week 18 2019 qb lamar jackson week 18 2021 qb aaron rodgers week 9 2023 qb lamar jackson week 18 that s 11 players out of 53 who missed even a single game during their mvp seasons many of those came at the end of the regular season with players sitting out to prep for a postseason run aside from rodgers positive covid test in 2021 no qb has missed a game due to injury in their mvp season since steve mcnair in 2003 of the five mvps who missed more than a single game three were running backs who racked up enough stats to run away with the award emmitt smith famously sat out the first two games in a contract standoff with the cowboys in 1993 mcnair split the award with peyton manning after missing a couple of late games with calf and ankle injuries the titans qb led the nfl in passer rating and yards per attempt that year mvp voters have leaned toward qbs who rack up stats and stay on the field in 2016 there was some chatter particularly in the northeast as to whether tom brady who missed the first four games of the season due to the deflategate suspension should be considered for the mvp after returning to lead the pats to an 11 1 record with a 28 2 td int ratio brady finished second to the falcons matt ryan with 20 of the vote montana s 1989 season for san francisco sits as the lone outlier despite missing three games montana was the best qb on the best team in the nfl winning the mvp vote in a landslide 62 of 70 votes the 49ers qb overcame the lack of counting stats by leading the nfl in all the efficiency categories 70 2 completion rate a 6 7 td rate 53 7 success rate 9 1 yards per attempt average 270 8 yards per game and set the then record with a 112 4 passer rating when 100 passer ratings were uncommon that s williams path to the mvp be the most efficient passer on the best team the bears qb currently sits second in completion percentage 70 9 fourth in interception rate 0 6 eighth in success rate 49 7 fifth in yards per attempt 8 0 11th in yards per game 253 4 fifth in passer rating 104 6 while ranking second in qbr 78 9 third in epa per dropback 0 22 and fifth in win probability added 117 0 overcoming missed games in terms of the mvp race is extremely difficult missing three is historically daunting williams isn t there yet but if he manhandles other defenses like he did a studly seahawks one on the road he ll have a shot at joining montana as an outlier in the record books now on to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition next in line bears qb caleb williams lions qb jared goff jahmyr gibbs drake maye
